judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Anand Venkatesh, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition and has also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. In view of the submissions and endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
